countries.reasoning: Based on recent industry reports and global chemical production data up to 2023; China leads PTFE production due to large chemical manufacturing capacity and export volume; data from China Chemical Industry Association and USGS reports provide reliable figures.

US is a major PTFE producer with several large chemical companies manufacturing PTFE resins; data from USGS and chemical industry sources from 2022-2023 supports production estimates with slight variability.
Germany has significant fluoropolymer production capacity; industry reports and European chemical market data for 2023 estimate substantial output, though not as large as China or US.
Japan is known for specialty fluoropolymer production including PTFE coatings; production figures are documented but exact details are proprietary and slightly less transparent.
India is an emerging PTFE producer with expanding chemical manufacturing; data is less precise compared to leaders but reported production capacity supports this estimate for 2023.
